name: Otera
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood Buddhist temple (Tokiwa-ji): a New Year's Eve bell-ringing time change, a first day volunteering on the temple grounds, a visiting-hours-and-fees guide, an omikuji price change, a how-to-pray manners guide, a lesson in rephrasing the difference between shrines and temples simply, a memorial-service booking mix-up and the lesson it teaches, the temple's history of switching from a paper reservation ledger to an app during Obon, an Obon reservation-app guide, a column on the debate behind photographing graves for SNS, a hybrid paper-ledger-plus-system guide for memorial-tablet records, a reflection on balancing quiet tradition with being open to tourists, and a three-hundredth-anniversary report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
